ops.body:
Intel with 1 worker
Question: PR438 Intel shard 0 failed one test: test_foreground_graph_latency_stays_bounded_while_registry_warms asserts p95 < 1.0 s and got 1.122 s. It is a wall-clock bound calibrated on ARM. On 7 green ARM main runs the test took 11.7–18.2 s; on Intel it took 26.2 s, and the whole shard ran 287 s against 81–128 s on ARM. Ubuntu x86 passes. Shard 1 carries the same kind of bounds (p95 < 0.75 and < 1.0), so the frozen all-Intel delta would likely fail the same way, and I have not pushed it. helper-test has no timing asserts. How should the PR get to green?
Options: Python ARM, helper Intel (Recommended) | Revert split, all ARM | Arch-aware p95 bounds | Intel with 1 worker
